raw:
“My first crop of strawberries on my balcony made me really happy. There were six ripe berries, all in one bowl. Six doesn’t sound like a lot, but when they’re ones you’ve grown yourself, it feels different. I kept looking at them and thinking, those actually grew here, on my balcony.

I saved two for a neighbor. That was part of the pleasure, having enough to share, even from such a little crop. Of course, two out of six is quite a bit when you look at it that way. But I liked that. I work as a supply clerk at an aquarium shop, so I’m used to thinking about quantities, and here I was getting excited over six strawberries.”
